idle.hint: Records the active tab, and follows you to other tabs
idle.video: Video of each scroll and press
recording.refused: Paused: Chrome doesn't let extensions record this page.
done.windowClosed: The recording ended because its window was closed.
done.debuggingCancelled: The recording ended because debugging was cancelled in Chrome.
settings.title: Recorder settings
settings.loadFailed: Settings could not be loaded. Restore defaults or choose a profile.
settings.saved: Saved. Extension language applies when pages open or reload.
settings.restored: Defaults restored. Extension language applies when pages open or reload.
settings.profileHelp: Path to a JSON-LD file included in this extension’s privacy folder. Changes apply to the next recording.
settings.videoScaleHelp: From 0.1 to 1. A scale of 1 preserves the original dimensions; 0.5 halves the width and height. Higher values create larger videos and take longer to process. Changes apply to the next recording.
settings.clickQuiet: Visual pause before ending a click (seconds)
settings.clickQuietHelp: How long to wait without a visual change after release. Increase this to capture pauses between fade-out and fade-in. Default: 0.25 seconds. Changes apply to the next recording.
settings.clickMaximumHelp: Maximum time to observe a response after a press. Must be at least as long as the visual pause. Default: 2 seconds. For slower tours, try a 1-second pause and a 5-second maximum. Changes apply to the next recording.
settings.tagsHelp: One tag per line. The report editor offers them as one-click suggestions; a new report starts with none.
